{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor platforms''' were conveyances powered by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] units. Smaller units could be used to mount [[Beamdrill/Legends|beamdrills]], such as [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation's]] [[G2-GE beamdrill/Legends|G2-GE]],<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> while others were large, open lifts that could transport personnel or cargo. The larger units were used aboard large [[repulsorlift harvester]]s such as [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian's]] [[HV6 Harvester Factory]] to transport cargo to and from the landing pads on top of the vehicle to internal cargo bays.<ref name="Ando">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref>
